newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho ups Malawi, Dwangwa sugar co stakes.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho ups Malawi, Dwangwa sugar co stakes.

text.p: British conglomerate Lonrho Plc said on Monday a unit increased its stakes in Sugar Corp of Malawi Ltd and Dwangwa Sugar Corp Ltd for a total of 18.1 million stg cash.
The unit, Lonrho Sugar Corp Ltd, increased its interest in Sugar Corp of Malawi (Sucoma) to 60 percent from 51 percent and raised its stake in Dwangwa Sugar to 49 percent from 27 percent.
Both companies own sugar cane plantations and factories in Malawi.
"The increased interest will improve dividend flows and permit the consolidation of Dwangwa," Lonrho said in a statement.
Sucoma had net assets of 22 million stg, while Dwangwa's level was 12.1 million stg.
